facts.summary: Modest hair regrowth in open-label study; only 20% of completers reached SALT ≤20 · Phase 2 · EQ101 in alopecia areata · not yet approved

evidence.summary: SALT ≤ 20 in 5 (29%) subjects 18.4 % mean reduction in SALT
evidence.safety: There were no Serious TEAEs or Grade 4 or 5 TEAEs
evidence.program_discontinued: Initial safety and efficacy data supports advancing EQ101 into further alopecia areata development to include dose regimen optimization
